visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 15 days.
visa-preparation.recheck_note: Not verified 2026-11-01: no Smartraveller advice. Search snapshots of the national law (smf.st) and the tourism office say a 15-day exemption covers listed nationalities and holders of a Schengen or US visa; Australia's place on the list and the e-visa fee weren't confirmed on an official page.

laws.rule: There are severe penalties for all drug offences. Pack all luggage yourself and do not carry anything through customs for anyone else.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs and prison sentences

laws.rule: Same-sex sexual activity is legal in São Tomé and Príncipe. Attitudes towards same-sex relationships are less tolerant than in the UK and showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers

laws.rule: Credit cards are not widely accepted in São Tomé and Príncipe. Check if your hotel or restaurant accepts credit cards. There are only a small number of ATMs. You can withdraw cash from the main bank in the capital city, São Tomé.
laws.heading: Money

local-law.note: From UK Government (FCDO) travel advice, written for British travellers; Smartraveller has no advice page for this place. Confirm with the place's own authorities.
